monitors.name: R01-LLM-inference-market
monitors.goal: Alert when new LLM API pricing, hosting offers, or competitor inference pricing tiers change in ways that affect Sovereign LLM Inference API positioning (R01). Ignore pure marketing fluff unless it changes price, limits, or SLAs.

monitors.name: Partner-DRP-funding-pipelines
monitors.goal: Alert when partner funding programs, Partner Services Funds, DRP registrations, cloud credits, or startup partner program terms change. Focus on eligibility, funding amounts, and registration deadlines.
